name: Maison Waterlot Paris
lead: One-man Paris house (Valentin Waterlot): three scents composed by hand in small batches from producer-sourced materials. No online shop; bottles are reserved directly with the house.

name: 1000 Flowers (Jessica Buchanan)
lead: Grasse atelier-boutique making small-batch perfumes in house with botanical materials. Already listed as a bespoke place; bespoke calendar reported full through 2027. Could become a full house card.

name: Bissoumine (Kitty Shpirer)
lead: Independent Grasse perfume house founded 2009 by an artist-perfumer who also creates scents for exhibitions, museums and performances. Public workshops not confirmed.

name: Poésie Parfumée
lead: Independent natural perfumer (Guillaume Bonnabaud La Bruyère) with his own collection and personalised perfume workshops; studio location to confirm. '100% natural' is the brand's own claim.

name: HF Perfumes (Hélène Prévot)
lead: Grasse perfumer with about 30 years' experience offering bespoke fragrance development, mostly for brands and labs (5 Place aux Aires, Grasse). Ask whether she takes private clients.

name: Le Comptoir Olfactif
lead: Mobile two-hour perfume-making workshops (2–8 people, 12+, French or English) where you leave with your own 30 ml bottle. Comes to you rather than a fixed studio; confirm area and price.

name: Arabian Oud (Kalemat)
lead: Large Saudi house. Kalemat is a warm amber-wood scent: saffron and cinnamon over vanilla and sandalwood. One scent, not a picture of the whole region.

name: Chasense (茶香师)
lead: Chinese tea-perfume house, 50 ml stone-shaped bottles; reportedly run by Shanghai Xinyin Cosmetics (brand around 2020). Teas include Spring Tea (Longjing, tangerine peel, pear blossom, licorice, vetiver), Biluochun, Osmanthus Oolong, Ganpu pu'er, Zentea Ya (bamboo, pear, cucumber, green tea, violet leaf, moss, incense) and Silver Needle white tea. Broken Silver (碎银子, Sui Yin Zi) is named after a pu'er tea; its published notes are bergamot and lemon, pu'er tea and roasted rice, on cedar and guaiac wood. The tea name doesn't tell us what's physically in the formula. Reseller observations: US$59.99 / 50 ml (Yami, US) and about ¥299 after coupon (Chinese marketplace index; an older listing showed ¥419) (per Nitah's verification check, 3 Nov 2026). Prices: about S$50–60 / 50 ml from a Singapore reseller (reported, 2025); a trade-fair catalogue lists Green Tea at ¥188 / 50 ml, Zentea Ya ¥319 and Silver Needle ¥389; its English site reportedly shows ¥268 for Spring Tea (all reported, not checked). Its site's award and supplier claims are unconfirmed.

name: Black Paw (黑爪)
lead: Chinese house (Shanghai origin reported by a Chinese business profile, not yet confirmed in a company registry; reportedly founded 2018 by Huang Jing, who came from aroma-material trading) with a big catalogue of named Chinese teas and plants. Tea line (茶香雅集): Bu Zhi Chun (rhubarb, rock tea, cashmere wood), Lushan Yunwu (green tea, orange, green leaves, rose, jasmine, musk), Silver Needle (pear, freesia, white tea, osmanthus, peony, musk), Hongyu Black Tea (ruby black tea, jasmine, labdanum, cedar, guaiac); also Phoenix Dancong, Dafo Longjing, jasmine pearl tea. Plant line: Catmint (猫薄荷, 50 ml; reported marjoram, lime and mint over gardenia, grass and rosemary, on cistus and musk; described from its published notes as a green, herbal scent; whether catnip itself is in the formula is not known either way), plus gardenia, pine, Buddha's hand, lotus. Overseas retail observations, kept separate: HK$328 (30 / 50 ml) at a Hong Kong shop, mostly sold out; Catmint about US$89 / 50 ml at a US reseller (Yami). Neither is a Chinese domestic price.

name: Fukudo (浮香堂)
lead: Chinese niche house founded in 2011, art-led (film, music, literature): Love Letter, Sakamoto, Maborosi, Forbidden Colors, Karesansui (sandalwood, cedar and moss with lotus, wisteria and incense), Samye Dawn. Perfumers on its list include Keizo Shinke, Rodrigo Flores-Roux, Yann Vasnier and Sophia Grojsman. A Fragrantica editorial (3 Dec 2025) reports it as Uttori's sister brand, founded together in 2011, with Fukudo the niche line and Uttori the accessible one; this is editorial reporting, not a corporate filing. It fits the Uttori box in the creator's video. Find a shop and price.

name: Arome Manpo (馥郁满铺)
lead: Not a classic perfume house: reportedly a three-storey fragrance-and-lifestyle concept store at 30 Donghu Road, Shanghai, built around tuberose, with a floral-tea and drinks bar and botanical skincare. Osmanthus Nectar is a 50 ml EDP with a stone cap. A US trademark filing (2026) covers drinks, not perfume. Confirm before treating it as a house. A creator who visited NOTES Shanghai 2026 bought Osmanthus Nectar and was told it's the brand's Hangzhou-exclusive scent.

name: Stellar Essence
lead: Black-bottle line with about 20 scents (Misty Hill, Ring of Saturn, Brumous Rose, Jazz Night, Oriental Sip); 50 ml. Notes and price not found yet. Fragrance databases list it as Chinese with a 2024 collection of 20–23 scents, including Floating Tea (天露清茶), Bamboo, Wild Pine and Green Moss. No official shop or perfumer found yet.

name: handhandhand (叁手)
lead: Shanghai design-led fragrance and body-care brand, founded in 2017 by three designers (creative director Chinlun Shen); ADA Cosmetics announced a hotel-amenities partnership on 1 Oct 2025 (a partnership, not an acquisition) (per Nitah's verification check, 3 Nov 2026). Its home fragrance and skincare are separate from the perfume range. Perfumes include Rebel Beige (50 ml, leather-wrapped cap), Black Sheep (lentisk, labdanum, incense), White Lie (白色修辭), First Blush (想入緋緋, bergamot and rose) and Out of Blue (空降繆思). Find a shop and price. Fine fragrance, home fragrance and candles, skincare, and hotel amenities are separate product lines.

name: The Beast (野兽派)
lead: Shanghai florist-turned-lifestyle brand (flowers, home, perfume). Oriental Beauty (东方美人, 2021, named after the oolong tea) is a fresh floral: citrus and blackcurrant, camellia, linden and tea, on ambergris and musk. Osmanthus Oolong (桂花乌龙, launched September 2020, 25 / 50 ml): sweet orange, mandarin and tea, then osmanthus and freesia, on apricot, leather and sandalwood; perfumer Alexandre Freile per a product record. The brand says it worked with Firmenich and used a natural golden-osmanthus absolute from China; that is the brand's own claim, not an audited supply chain (per Nitah's verification check, 3 Nov 2026). Find a checked price.

name: Hamidi water perfumes (alcohol-free)
lead: UAE house Hamidi's alcohol-free 100 ml musk water perfumes: Musk Hamidi, Vanilla Elixir, Jasmine Bud & Tuberose, Silk Musk, Black Musk. Price observations, kept separate: Rs 500 at a Pakistani reseller (reported); ₹699 and unavailable on Hamidi India's own page; ₹420 promo against ₹700 MRP at another Indian shop (per Nitah's verification check, 3 Nov 2026). Find notes.

name: Arty Scents
lead: Small UK maker (founded 2025, per its founder) of handmade alcohol-free 'Eau Fraîche' perfumes; the brand says they contain aloe vera and vitamin E. Curated Collection: Sacred Mint & Myrtle (corn mint, lemon myrtle), Zesty Orange & Sandalwood (neroli, sandalwood), Dreamy Caribbean Sunrise (lime, coconut). Its shop shows 10 ml two for £8 and 50 ml two for £30 (per Nitah's verification check, 3 Nov 2026).

name: ScentLegacy (Hamilton, Ontario)
lead: Perfumery-materials seller based in Hamilton, Ontario (Etsy listings show Iso E Super, Hedione HC, Ambroxan and Orbitone T); its creator reviews indie houses, interviews perfumers and hunts fragrance across Asia. Decants are advertised on its link page but no live decant listing was confirmed (per Nitah's verification check, 3 Nov 2026).

name: MAT KURO atelier (Shanghai)
lead: Creator-reported lead: a Shanghai atelier making handmade, stone-textured perfume bottles reportedly set with natural stones from Yunnan, with the bottle design, colours and scent customisable. No official site, registration, address or booking channel found, so it is not on the map (per Nitah's verification check, 3 Nov 2026).

name: Nafees (alcohol-free hair & body)
country: To confirm (Gulf brand, sold in India)
lead: Alcohol-free hair-and-body perfumes in tall pastel bottles: Tangerine Breeze (fruity, fresh, clean) and Musk Delight (clean, musky white floral). An Indian creator lists them at ₹300 each (reported). Find the maker, notes and an official price.

name: Al-Nuaim (UAE, alcohol-free)
lead: UAE house of alcohol-free perfumes, attars and deodorants (sold on Noon and Amazon): Chocolate Musk, Sana roll-on, Candy body spray, Taif Rose, Vanille Kizali. Featured in a paid creator collab. Find notes and prices.

name: Kankshi Naturals (solid perfume)
lead: Indian maker of alcohol-free solid perfumes in 12 g sliding tins. One is sold as 'inspired by CK One' (a declared big-brand inspiration): bergamot, lemon and lime; jasmine, green tea and lily; musk, sandalwood and amber; ₹399 with free delivery in India, per the brand's post (not checked on its shop).

name: Dizurde Musk al Tahara
lead: Musk al Tahara (white 'purity' musk) in a small boxed format, viral on TikTok as a deodorant swap. Confirm the maker's country, format and price before using it.

name: Solid perfume tins (India)
lead: Solid perfumes seen in 'non-alcoholic perfumes for everyday' searches. NOYZ (US, launched through the Florence by Mills incubator): solid sticks, US$42 each on its own shop, 7 g in its pairs, many sold out when checked; Love Club is saffron, Sichuan pepper, mandarin and bergamot, then leather, rose, raspberry and violet, on marshmallow, woods, patchouli and amber; Lost+Found is citrus-woody and Sh**ty Day amber-aromatic (no full notes listed). Official sites found, products not yet read: Cieal (cieal.com, Instagram @ciealperfumes) 10 g tins (Sandalwood, Pink Bloom, Kobra, Aqua Blue, Jasmine, Blue Lady, White Oudh, Royal Miraj, Maryam, Jordan, Absee, Floral) and Amafhh (houseofamafhh.com, Instagram @amafhhperfumes) Herbarium pocket tins.

name: Jovoy Paris (Fire at Will)
lead: Paris niche house and boutique. Fire at Will (perfumer Vania Muracciole) is a soft brown-sugar vanilla: vanilla and mimosa, then brown sugar, on musk, amber and vetiver. Sold in Canada at H Parfums, Montreal: CA$260 / 75 ml, CA$75 / 15 ml, CA$9.50 sample (checked at the shop). Seen in a creator's weekly rotation.

name: mochiglow
lead: Small brand of Asian-dessert gourmand EDPs in white bottles; its limited Milk & Cream line (Rice Milk, Pandan Cream, Banana Milk, Cream Puff, Melon Milk) is on its last restock, per the brand. Find origin, notes and price.

name: Arabiyat Prestige and Riiffs (new releases)
lead: New Gulf releases shown by a creator: Arabiyat Prestige Mahd Al Dhahab extrait (faceted gold bottle), Kohl Luminous and Kohl Opulence extraits; Riiffs Momento Liquid Gold, Veloce and Golden Elixir Crimson. Notes and prices to find. The creator compares Golden Elixir Crimson to a big-brand cognac scent (see twins).

name: Rosie Jane (Dulce)
lead: Small US clean-fragrance brand founded by Rosie Jane Johnston. Dulce (2022) is a dessert vanilla: vanilla and brown sugar, then dulce de leche and vanilla blossom, on hinoki wood, tonka, amber and sugar cane (notes per Parfumo). A creator layers it with Kyse Perfumes' Delizia di Marshmallow for a rich but not cloying dessert scent. Price still to check on the brand's shop.

name: Kyse Perfumes (Delizia di Marshmallow)
lead: Indie house behind Delizia di Marshmallow (2019): a straightforward sugared marshmallow and vanilla. US$95 / 60 ml at Luckyscent (checked; on backorder). A creator layers it with by/Rosie Jane Dulce. Where the house is based is not stated by the shop.

name: Brunbae and Hair Drama (Indian hair and body mists)
lead: Official sites found, products not yet read. Brunbae (brunbae.com, Instagram @brunbae.in): Sweet Seduction 50 ml (peach and coconut in its ads); Celestial Sass already checked at ₹1,199 / 50 ml. Hair Drama Co. (hairdramacompany.com, Instagram @hairdramaco): Marshmallow Whip hair perfume mist with rice protein, 20 ml.
